changelog:
Wake Learning, Floating Mic, Auto Volume, Dream Clock, Liquid Glass.

Clone: LAN pairing code transfers setup between Ava devices. 6-digit code, 5-min window, encrypted LAN exchange. Select voice, browser, mods, launcher, widgets individually. HA/MA credentials excluded by default. MAC and ESPHome name never leave source. Path: Settings → Backup & restore → Clone.

Wake learning: on-device training from positive/negative samples. Cross-validation at 90% retention before publishing. OpenWakeWord embedding runs native C++ instead of ONNX. Settings show learning state, retrain, clear. Path: Settings → Voice configuration → Wake learning.

Floating mic: Voice/Button/Hybrid modes. D-handle rests, disc when pulled. Tap VAD finish, hold-to-talk, tap during STT/TTS restarts listening. Music ducks while speaking. Centered 3-line subtitle reply. Remote/D-pad navigation supported. Path: Settings → Voice configuration → Wake mode.

Auto volume: idle mic estimates room noise, adds to TTS slider. Quiet room keeps set value, loud room +55 points max. HA volume entity follows actual output. Off by default. Thanks #209. Path: Settings → Voice configuration → Voice reply.

Dream Clock: flip face, Duo layout, seasons (spring/summer/autumn/winter). Black/white/color themes swipe. Analog face numeral placement corrected. HA timer entity bindable. Theme entity for automations. Path: Settings → Screensaver → Dream Clock.

Update disclosure: leads with this device, others next. HA update entity immediate recheck. Later remembered, not per-launch. Path: Settings → Device service → Software update.

Music: Noise handshake + plaintext fallback 3 min. Cover/artist/title update after track change. Lyrics skip bad duration fit. Clock calibration follows speaker time. German "Stopp" recognized. TTS first 300ms guarded.

Liquid Glass: sidebar, floating windows, notifications, volume, dock. Settings lists clear. 10dp inset, rounded corners, scroll dissolve. Intensity 50%, 2s preview. Light thin edge, dark black-grey. Off leaves no blur. Portal compact desktop icons fixed. Rooted floating windows uid 0 fixed. Landscape default left index + right detail. Remote-control focus navigation. Path: Settings → App style → Liquid Glass.

Fixes: Camera Vision EAN/UPC #206. Echo Show rooted overlay #208. TTS ambient noise #209.
